component.name: ViPER FX
component.summary: ViPER4Android's effects for all the desktop's sound

description.p: ViPER4Android's sound effects (ViPER bass and clarity, Headphone Surround+, field and differential surround, FIR equalizer, convolver, ViPER-DDC, dynamic system, reverb, tube simulator, AnalogX, playback gain control) on DeskDroid's PipeWire sound server, without root. It uses ViPERFX_RE, the open reimplementation of ViPER4Android's engine.
